name: Letterhead
summary: Gentle, bookish newsletter site set entirely in EB Garamond, with painterly misty-landscape banners, soft green-grey bento tiles and one deep forest-green accent.

fonts.pairing: one classical serif for everything; italic for meta, labels and the signature, regular 400 for all headings

signature: painterly watercolour landscape (mist, mountains, pavilions) inside 24px-radius banners, fading to white behind centred serif headlines
bento feature tiles that illustrate the promise with tiny data graphics: a reading-time bar, a source grid with a few lit cells, a globe with a percentage
imagery: soft AI-painted watercolour landscapes and small illustrated objects, one warm portrait of the writer, pastel issue thumbnails
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 40px side padding, 120px section padding, 24px radii on every card and banner, bento 2+3 grid
